title: 序章3 记忆序章4 获取信息
content_zh:
“喀嚓嚓~”
沉寂的气氛中，地板的裂缝缓缓蔓延。
“矮子，再给你一次机会，我权当没有看到过你的无礼。”
然而，黎木身前的小女孩就像没有听到对方的话一般。
“为食物道歉！”
稚嫩的声音不容置疑，命令般的口吻让不懂语言的黎木也能感受到不妙。
“轰！
！”
下一刻，大量的石板震荡碎裂开，恐怖的气势自对面惊涛般掀起。
“你的诉求是死，我可以这么理解吗？”
黎木能够感受到心跳的急剧加速，本能的求生欲让他想尽快逃离这里，可他全四肢瘫软，动弹不得。
相反的，他身前的那名小女孩却丝毫不受影响。
“道歉。”
此话一出。
就连周围的异族也有不少闭上了眼睛。
“噼里啪啦~”
一块块地板碎块被碾成齑粉。
不行，不能这么下去，如果这些怪物打起来，自己极大可能会死。
呼~吸~呼~吸~
黎木鼓起勇气，张开口：“停...”

然而，还没等黎木说出话，自己身体就被一双手臂拖了起来，随即一阵天旋地转...
待到重新睁开眼。
陌生的天花板，四周是被装饰过的墙壁。
“这是...牢房？”
“没错呦，这是我的牢房。”
顺着声音看去，只见一抹香白遮住了黎木的全部视野。
“我可是好久没见到雄性了~”
声音魅惑力十足，仿佛撩骚进人的骨头一般，整个人都酥麻了。
“好香...魅魔...魅魔！
？”
黎木猛地甩了甩头，惊异的看着眼前魅力异常的女孩：“你也能听懂我说的话？你想要做什么？”
魅魔似乎有些惊讶于黎木的定力。
缓缓扑闪小翅膀落地，玉足蹑蹑来到黎木身旁。
“哎呀，你可真坏，你都知道我是魅魔了，还问我要做什么~”
content_en:
"Kachacha~"
In the silent atmosphere, the cracks in the floor slowly spread.
"Dwarf, let me give you another chance. I will pretend that I have never seen your rudeness."
However, the little girl in front of Li Mu seemed not to hear what the other party said.
“Apologies for the food!”
The childish voice was unmistakable, and the commanding tone made Li Mu, who didn't understand the language, feel something was wrong.
"Boom!
! "
The next moment, a large number of stone slabs vibrated and shattered, and a terrifying momentum rose from the opposite side like a thunderous wave.
"Your request is to die, can I understand that?"
Li Mu could feel his heartbeat rapidly accelerating, and his instinctive desire to survive made him want to escape from here as soon as possible, but his limbs were paralyzed and he could not move.
On the contrary, the little girl in front of him was not affected at all.
"Apologise."
As soon as these words came out.
Even many of the surrounding alien races closed their eyes.
"Crackling~"
Pieces of floorboards were ground into powder.
No, we can't go on like this. If these monsters fight, I will most likely die.
Breathe in, breathe in, breathe in, breathe in
Li Mu mustered up his courage and opened his mouth: "Stop..."
However, before Li Mu could say anything, his body was dragged up by a pair of arms, and then the world began to spin...
Wait until you open your eyes again.
An unfamiliar ceiling, surrounded by decorated walls.
"Is this...a cell?"
"Yes, this is my cell."
Following the sound, he saw a wisp of fragrant white covering Li Mu's entire field of vision.
"I haven't seen a male for a long time~"
The voice is full of charm, as if it is tingling into one's bones, and the whole person is numb.
“Smells so good...succubus...succubus!
? "
Li Mu shook his head suddenly and looked at the extremely charming girl in front of him in surprise: "Can you understand what I said? What do you want to do?"
The succubus seemed a little surprised by Li Mu's determination.
Slowly fluttering its small wings, it landed on the ground, and tiptoed to Li Mu's side.
"Oh, you are so bad. You already know that I am a succubus, and you still ask me what I want to do~"
